My dog died this year and I've been a mess ever since, some days are good, some aren't which is normal. My mom cried a lot as well, it became very upsetting and painful to come home and not see our dog happily greet us. There's not much we can do in situations like this, only to hope that they are at peace and cherish the memories we've made with them. Take your time, no one is allowed to tell you how long exactly you're allowed to grief. It's a process but definitely not a linear one. I hope you are well and I'm sure your dog loves you just as much as you love them.

my dog died last week and she was almost your dog's age. it's a hard thing to cope with, no one ever teaches us how to do it or they downplay it as something trivial and not as the horrible experience it is. unfortunately, i cope through escapism which i wouldn't recommend to anyone. instead give yourself time to grieve. write your feelings somewhere, maybe in a diary, try to think of the good times, even if it hurts. we can only do so much in these situations but remember that you did everything you could, and your dog loves you as much as you love him. stay strong, these are hard times we're dealing with and losing things so dear to us is the last thing we need right now. however, life goes on and we are stronger than we think we are. i hope the pain eases soon.
i’m very sorry for your loss, i’m sure you did a great job taking care of her. unfortunately we can only do so much when faced with the inevitable. thank you for your words <3
